# CI-only version pins for the linux-integration `gates` job.
#
# These freeze the reverse-engineering backends that otherwise float within
# their pyproject floors (e.g. android = "frida>=16.5"), so a gate run is
# reproducible and an upstream release cannot silently change the API a gate
# exercises -- the exact drift that removed Memory.readByteArray in frida 17 and
# broke frida.memory_read until the client moved to ptr().readByteArray.
#
# Applied only through `pip install -c` in the workflow, never in pyproject, so
# production/runtime consumers keep the flexible floors and only CI is frozen.
#
# Only the leaf backends are pinned, never their shared transitive deps
# (pydantic, typing-extensions, ...). The resolver still settles those to the
# consistent set the job documents -- pydantic 2.11 with the typing-extensions
# 4.14 that also satisfies mitmproxy's typing-extensions<=4.14 -- so pinning
# here does not disturb that balance (verified: `pip check` clean with these
# pins on ubuntu-24.04 / CPython 3.12, pydantic resolving to 2.11.10).
#
# Bump deliberately, like the Ghidra/jadx/apktool/webcrack/OS pins, after
# re-running the gates against the new versions.
adbutils==2.12.0
androguard==4.1.4
frida==17.17.0
mitmproxy==12.2.3
playwright==1.62.0
